Class Param<T>

java.lang.Object
frc.spectrumLib.params.Param<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the value type
Direct Known Subclasses:
BooleanParam, DoubleParam, IntParam, StringParam
public abstract sealed class Param<T> extends Object permits DoubleParam, IntParam, BooleanParam, StringParam
One tunable value, declared in code with a name, type, default, units and optional bounds, and resolved from the layers described in Params. Declare params through a ParamGroup. Read and change them on the main thread only.
